mentions.name: Adeptli
mentions.description: This pay-as-you-go platform aims to make personalized learning available to anyone with an internet connection. Everyone starts with free credits so they can try it out without incurring costs if they don't find it useful. It is still very early in development.
mentions.problem: Personalized learning is not readily available or affordable to everyone; costs can deter people from trying it
mentions.audience: Anyone with an internet connection who wants personalized learning
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://adeptli.org with the goal of making personalized learning available to anyone with an internet connection. It's pay-as-you-go, and everyone starts with free credits to check it out and not incur costs if they don't find it useful.
